hook.name: StonkHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Stonkdrops memecoin launchpad that charges a 1% base tax plus an optional creator fee on every swap's quote leg, routing 70% to a StonkFund raindrop pool and 30% to the treasury. Applies an anti-snipe tax in the first seconds after launch and reports USD volume back to the launchpad for vesting and stats.
